correctness.rationale: In a finite structure with two named binary graphs R_f,R_g of total bijections, relation commutativity fg=gf is a property of the pair, not of each individual cycle type. Atomic 2-types (x=y, f(x)=y, f(y)=x, g(x)=y,g(y)=x) and stable color refinement capture C^2-equivalence with counting in this signature. Independently enumerated ALL n!^2 labelled permutation pairs for n=1..5, obtaining 1,4,11,43,154 initial/stable atomic profile categories with no mixing of commute/noncommute. For n=6 the given explicit fixed f=(1,0,3,2,5,4), g_comm=(2,3,4,5,0,1), g_non=(2,4,1,5,3,0) are distinct commute-status but have identical uniform atomic types, hence are C^2-equivalent. Independent simultaneous conjugacy reduction over eleven partitions of six enumerated 901 classes; independently stabilized the complete atomic 2-type partitions for each, obtaining 860 color-refinement signature classes and exactly 3 mixed classes, with commuting/noncommuting representative counts (4,3),(2,2),(2,2). This validates sharp minimum n=6 and the full stated six-point mixed-class census, not merely a sampled witness. The logic is two-variable counting over directed graphs of total bijections, not a language of unary permutations or higher-variable formulas.

originality.rationale: Primary Kiefer–Schweitzer–Selman arXiv:1503.08792 develops color-refinement/C² equivalence for colored directed graph structures, including six-vertex phenomena for arbitrary colored graphs. Such generic separation examples do not prove this exact least domain size for two total functional bijection relations and the algebraic predicate fg=gf. Related permutation distance/commutation papers address Hamming distance or enumeration, not elementary equivalence of commuting and noncommuting pairs. Comparisons were by exact relation signature, predicate and implication, rather than title. A published more general C² classification under bounded-degree edge-coloured digraphs could potentially imply it, retained as priority risk.
residual_risks: A fully general classification of C² equivalence among permutation-group actions might subsume the six-point threshold but was not identified in inspected primary work.
The six-point census is exact finite enumeration, not a claim about larger n or stronger counting logics.
